ar.title: الفتَة (الثريد)

steps.n1: يطهى الأرز الأبيض مثل الطريقة السابقة.
steps.n2: يقطع الخبز قطعا صغيرة ويحمر في الزيت أو السمن أو يدخل الفرن.
steps.n3: يسخن الزيت أو السمن ويحمر فيه الثوم حتى يصفر، ثم يضاف إليه الخل ويقلب جيدا على درجة حرارة متوسطة.
steps.n4: نضيف الصلصة المخففة بقليل من المرق وتقلب جيدا مع الملح والفلفل.
steps.n5: نأخذ جزءا من هذه الصلصة ونضعه في طبق صغير لتجميل وجه الأرز.
steps.n6: نضيف المرق المملح إلى بقية الصلصة حتى الغليان، ثم نسكبها على الخبز المحمر حتى يتشرب تماما.
steps.n7: نحضر طبقا كبيرا للتقديم ونضع نصف كمية الخبز وفوقه نصف كمية الأرز ثم الخبز ثم نصف الأرز الباقي، ونضع الصلصة المحفوظة لتجميل الأرز.

en.title: Fatta (Thareed) with Rice and Garlic-Tomato Sauce

steps.n1: Cook the white rice using the standard method.
steps.n2: Cut the bread into small pieces and toast them in oil or ghee, or bake them in the oven.
steps.n3: Heat the oil or ghee and sauté the garlic until golden, then add the vinegar and stir well over medium heat.
steps.n4: Add the tomato paste diluted with a little broth and stir well with salt and pepper.
steps.n5: Set aside a portion of this sauce in a small bowl to garnish the top of the rice later.
steps.n6: Add the salted broth to the remaining sauce and bring to a boil, then pour it over the toasted bread until it is fully soaked.
steps.n7: Prepare a large serving platter; layer half of the bread, followed by half of the rice, then the remaining bread, and finally the rest of the rice, topping it with the reserved sauce for garnish.

legacySteps: Cook the white rice using the standard method.
Cut the bread into small pieces and toast them in oil or ghee, or bake them in the oven.
Heat the oil or ghee and sauté the garlic until golden, then add the vinegar and stir well over medium heat.
Add the tomato paste diluted with a little broth and stir well with salt and pepper.
Set aside a portion of this sauce in a small bowl to garnish the top of the rice later.
Add the salted broth to the remaining sauce and bring to a boil, then pour it over the toasted bread until it is fully soaked.
Prepare a large serving platter; layer half of the bread, followed by half of the rice, then the remaining bread, and finally the rest of the rice, topping it with the reserved sauce for garnish.
